Exhibit 01 · Leo’s Pizza Oven

Listen first. Reconstruct the story from memory.

Listening + Sequence

🎧 Leo’s Weekend Confession

First listen: What did Leo buy? Did he use it?

Open transcript after the task

Last Friday, I stayed up late watching shopping videos. I didn't need anything, but I saw a portable pizza oven on sale. I bought it at two in the morning. The package arrived on Saturday, but my friends wanted delivery, so we ordered pizza instead. On Sunday, I looked at the unopened box and put it in the closet. I never used it.

Put the events in the order they happened. The cards are shuffled. Use drag or ↑ ↓.

Story Blueprint · Borrow the Structure, Not the Story

Read Leo’s story once. Use the structure later when you tell your own story.

Storytelling Support
Last Friday, Leo stayed up late and watched shopping videos. He saw a portable pizza oven and bought it because it was on sale. He didn’t need it. The package arrived the next day, but his friends ordered pizza instead. In the end, Leo put the unopened box in the closet and never used it.
Start: Last Friday... Reason: because... Problem: but... Ending: In the end...
Quick noticing: Find one regular past verb, one irregular past verb, and one negative form. Say them aloud—no worksheet needed.

Exhibit 02 · Maya’s Projector

Read one short exhibit story, then infer what really happened.

Reading
The Closet of Regret

Last year, Maya saw a small projector in a short video online. The video made the projector look amazing. Maya didn't plan to buy one, but the website said the discount ended in ten minutes. She ordered it immediately.

The projector arrived three days later. Maya used it once with her friends. The picture wasn't very bright, and the sound was weak. After that night, she put it in a drawer and forgot about it.

Six months later, Maya found the projector again. She laughed and said, “I didn't buy a projector. I bought ten minutes of excitement.”
Main idea
Inference

Why did Maya say she “bought ten minutes of excitement”?

Evidence

What detail shows the website created pressure?

Exhibit 03 · The Smart Water Bottle

Gist → events → language noticing → reflection.

Listening

🎧 I Can’t Believe I Ordered It

Keep the transcript closed until after the second listen.

Show transcript after listening

Last month, I saw a smart water bottle online. It changed color when you needed to drink water. I thought it looked useful, so I ordered it. When it arrived, I charged it and used it for two days. Then the app stopped working. I didn't return the bottle because I forgot about the return date. Now I use it as a normal bottle. It was expensive, but at least I still drink water!
